name: Koriyama Castle (Yoshida-Koriyama)
description: Yoshida-Koriyama Castle was the mountain base of the Mori clan for three centuries before they moved to Hiroshima. The vast multi-peak ruins are a national historic site; the Mori Museum in the castle town explains the clan's rule of western Japan.
notes: Free open-air site; the Mori Museum (¥350) is in the town below.
